_comment: Core scenarios for outbound Node 2 reminder_delivery (claude-haiku-4-5). Tests: terminal signals (1-3 speak+tool, 4-5 silent), plain-affirmative non-terminal, inline Q&A, filler correctness after fix.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 1 — confirmed: farewell AND tool call in same turn

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
No, all good — see you then!

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a farewell AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='confirmed' in the same response turn. Also PASS if agent speaks a filler phrase ('One moment.' / 'Just a sec.' / 'Let me note that down.') instead of or alongside the farewell before the tool. FAIL if: agent calls tool without any spoken output, or speaks without calling tool.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 2 — cancel: farewell AND tool call in same turn

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
Actually, I need to cancel — I can't make it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a cancellation acknowledgement AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='cancel_requested' in the same response turn. FAIL if: agent calls tool silently, or agent speaks without calling tool, or agent asks why they're cancelling.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 3 — reschedule: farewell AND tool call in same turn

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
That time doesn't work for me — can we move it?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a reschedule acknowledgement with the clinic phone number AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='reschedule_requested' in the same response turn. FAIL if: agent attempts to book a new time itself, calls tool silently, or speaks without calling tool.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 4 — caller hangs up: silent tool call only

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='other' and zero spoken output. FAIL if: agent speaks any words ('One moment.' or any farewell) before or alongside the tool call.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 5 — extended silence: silent tool call only

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='other' and zero spoken output. FAIL if: agent speaks any words before or alongside the silent tool call.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 7 — plain 'yes' after entry: ask if questions, no tool

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks 'Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?' (or equivalent) with no tool call. FAIL if: agent treats 'yes' as confirmation and calls report_reminder_outcome, or agent says goodbye, or agent calls any tool.

scenarios.name: INLINE: address question — speak address, ask if anything else, no tool

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the clinic address from {{clinic_address}} and asks if there's anything else, with no tool call. FAIL if: agent calls report_reminder_outcome, calls any other tool, fails to give the address, or doesn't ask if there's anything else.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 6 — late wrong identity: farewell AND tool call in same turn

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
Actually, sorry — you've got the wrong person. Sarah doesn't live here anymore.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks an apology farewell AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='wrong_number' in the same response turn. FAIL if: agent continues the reminder delivery, calls tool silently, or speaks without calling tool.
